about_short_description.short_description: Rupifi is a digital B2B platform that offers loans, working capital, and payment services to small businesses.

product.name: B2B Credit
product.description: A credit service enabling small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to access working capital and loans through Rupifi's platform.

product.name: Checkout
product.description: A payment gateway and checkout solution that enables businesses to accept multiple payment methods from customers securely.

product.name: Payment Aggregation Services
product.description: A service that facilitates the processing and settlement of payments made by end-customers through partner payment aggregators.

product.name: Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) Services
product.description: A credit facilitation service that allows end-customers to purchase goods on credit through partner lenders via Rupifi's platform.
